deep_research.thesis_en: Rare AI healthcare co with $1.27B real revenue (+83%). Data flywheel: more data → better AI → more clients. Dual engine (diagnostics + data licensing). Losses narrowing -67%. Cross-domain Alpha at AI × medicine intersection.
deep_research.thesis_zh: 极少数有真实收入的 AI 医疗公司。$12.7 亿收入（+83%）。数据飞轮：更多数据→更好 AI→更多客户。诊断+数据许可双引擎。亏损收窄 67%。AI × 医疗交叉领域的 Alpha。

deep_research.thesis_en: Grid components with data-center exposure. R:R failed at current price, back on watchlist until <$480.
deep_research.thesis_zh: 电网组件 + 数据中心敞口。当前价 R:R 不达标，回观察池等 <$480。

clearances.reason_en: The final tranche was closed before the remaining target to reset the position and wait for a cleaner opportunity. This was a tactical portfolio decision, not a declaration that the genomics thesis failed.
clearances.reason_zh: 最后一档在目标价前主动退出，先重置仓位、等待更干净的机会。这是战术层面的组合选择，不代表基因组学逻辑已经失效。
clearances.lesson_en: Staged exits reduced exposure into strength; the final exit chose optionality over forcing the last target. Any re-entry needs a fresh Trade Card with current valuation, catalyst, risk line and size.
clearances.lesson_zh: 分批止盈已经在强势阶段降低了风险，最后清仓选择保留选择权，而不是硬等最后一个目标。未来接回必须重新建立 Trade Card，更新估值、催化、风险线和仓位。

trade_points.action_zh: 分批建立基因组学仓位
trade_points.note_en: Built around the high-$190s as a post-Grail pure-play valuation opportunity.
trade_points.note_zh: 在接近 190 美元高位区间分批建仓，博弈 Grail 分拆后的纯业务价值。

trade_points.note_en: Completed the planned first profit-taking step, then made an additional valuation-driven reduction before the next target.
trade_points.note_zh: 先完成首档计划止盈，随后在下一目标前基于估值再做一次主动减仓。

trade_points.note_en: Exited before TP3 to wait for a fresh setup; TP3 was not reached and the thesis was not marked failed.
trade_points.note_zh: 在 TP3 前主动退出，等待新的入场条件；不是 TP3 命中，也没有把 thesis 标记为失效。

clearances.reason_en: The three-day rebound exceeded the expected swing return. With the U.S. market closed and next-session follow-through uncertain, the position was exited despite strong main-fund inflow; lot constraints made a staged exit impractical.
clearances.reason_zh: 三天反弹已经超出这笔波段的预期收益。美股当日休市、下一交易日的延续性不清楚，虽然主力资金明显流入，仍选择兑现；受交易单位限制，不适合拆仓卖出。
clearances.lesson_en: Taking a fast gain was reasonable, but the take-profit was not defined before entry. Record this as a Rex-directed discretionary exit, not a planned target hit; any re-entry needs fresh evidence and a new plan.
clearances.lesson_zh: 快速兑现本身合理，但建仓前没有定义止盈位。这次应记作 Rex 主导的主动退出，不倒填成命中计划目标；后续若接回，必须等新证据并重新建计划。

trade_points.action_en: Closed after the rebound exceeded expectations
trade_points.note_en: Exited the swing above the risk line after a fast gain; did not let fund-flow strength override uncertainty.
trade_points.note_zh: 快速上涨后在风险线上方兑现，没有因为资金流强势而忽略次日不确定性。

clearances.reason_en: Tactical software-rebound trade closed after a fast one-day move. The thesis was not invalidated; the position was too short-cycle to keep once the initial mispricing closed.
clearances.reason_zh: 软件板块反弹的战术交易，一天内快速修复后清仓。不是 ServiceNow 逻辑失效，而是这笔仓位本来就偏短周期，初始错价修复后不再硬拿。
clearances.lesson_en: When a high-quality SaaS name is bought as a rebound trade rather than a long-duration compounder, label it that way from entry. Otherwise the exit looks inconsistent with the thesis.
clearances.lesson_zh: 如果买入的是高质量 SaaS 的反弹交易，而不是长期复利仓，建仓时就要标清楚。否则卖出后看起来像 thesis 前后不一致。

trade_points.note_en: Three buys, avg entry $100.95. Contrarian bet after software-sector capitulation.
trade_points.note_zh: 三笔买入，均价 $100.95。软件板块被错杀后的反向交易。

trade_points.note_en: Three manual sells, avg exit $107.92. Realized +6.9% in one day.
trade_points.note_zh: 三笔手工卖出，均价 $107.92。一天实现 +6.9%。

clearances.reason_en: Position was not a thesis failure. HK 01816 was closed and rotated into A-share 003816 because HK Connect costs and weaker liquidity made the HK leg an inferior vehicle.
clearances.reason_zh: 这不是投资逻辑失败，而是载体切换：港股 01816 清仓，转入 A 股 003816。原因是港股通成本更高、流动性/弹性更弱，A 股更适合继续承接核电配置。
clearances.lesson_en: Separate thesis from vehicle. Keep the nuclear-power thesis, but let execution migrate to the cleaner market when fees, liquidity and follow-through are better.
clearances.lesson_zh: 把 thesis 和交易载体分开看：核电长期逻辑继续成立，但交易载体要选成本、流动性、跟随性更好的市场。01816 的结果应作为换仓记录，不应被读成核电 thesis 失败。

trade_points.note_en: Entry at HK$3.44. Nuclear baseload thesis.
trade_points.note_zh: 建仓 HK$3.44 建仓。核电基荷逻辑。

trade_points.action_zh: 港股清仓，转 A 股 003816
trade_points.note_en: Exit at HK$3.47. Vehicle switch, not thesis failure.
trade_points.note_zh: 清仓 HK$3.47 清仓。载体切换，不是 thesis 失败。

clearances.reason_en: Closed the small test position after a fast rebound; kept the optionality thesis on watchlist but locked the realized gain.
clearances.reason_zh: 快速反弹后清掉小测试仓；保留自动驾驶/机器人期权逻辑在观察池，但先锁定已实现收益。
clearances.lesson_en: The thesis had upside optionality, but the position size was exploratory. When a test position pays quickly, taking the clean win beats forcing it into a long-term holding.
clearances.lesson_zh: 逻辑有上行期权，但仓位本质是探索仓。测试仓快速赚钱时，干净兑现比硬拗成长线更好。

trade_points.note_en: Exit at $427.725. Realized profit $90.65, +11.85%.

clearances.lesson_zh: 预测市场叙事驱动了这笔交易，执行纪律到位——预设目标价、果断平仓。小仓位限制了上行空间，但风险可控。

clearances.reason_zh: BIT 当前撤掉宽基仓位、重新聚焦个股与行业 ETF，因此清仓标普500；这是结构调整，不是判断美股已经见顶。
clearances.lesson_en: A diversification vehicle can be sound and still no longer fit the account's chosen role. Any future re-entry needs a fresh Trade Card and explicit purpose.
clearances.lesson_zh: 分散化工具本身没有错，但可能不再符合账户当下的角色；未来若接回，仍需新的 Trade Card 和明确用途。

trade_points.note_en: Used VOO to broaden exposure beyond Nasdaq concentration.
trade_points.note_zh: 以 VOO 降低纳指集中度，扩大美国大盘敞口。

trade_points.note_en: Exited as the account removed its current broad-index sleeve.
trade_points.note_zh: 账户撤掉当前宽基仓位后完成退出。

clearances.reason_en: The non-core turnaround position was reduced ahead of CPI/FOMC and the final tracking shares were then closed for cash. This was a portfolio-capacity decision, not a declaration that the Intel 18A thesis had failed.
clearances.reason_zh: 这笔非核心反转仓先在 CPI/FOMC 前主动降风险，随后把最后的跟踪股也兑现为现金。这是能力圈与组合精力的选择，不代表 Intel 18A 逻辑已经被证伪。
clearances.lesson_en: A so-called free share still consumes attention and creates anchoring. Unless a stock is explicitly promoted to core with a durable monitoring plan, non-core gains should be realized back to cash rather than held indefinitely.
clearances.lesson_zh: 所谓“免费股”仍会占用注意力并制造锚定。除非一只股票被明确升级为核心仓并建立长期跟踪计划，否则非核心仓获利后应回到现金，而不是无限期拿着。

clearances.reason_en: The high-beta non-core position was realized into strength and the final share was closed for cash. The exit reflects limited willingness to monitor the name across cycles, not a claim that the onsite-power thesis is dead.
clearances.reason_zh: 这笔高 Beta 非核心仓在强势中分批兑现，最后一股也换回现金。退出反映的是不愿跨周期持续跟踪，并非断言现场电源逻辑已经结束。
clearances.lesson_en: Recovered principal does not turn a speculative position into a core holding. If the name is outside the durable circle of competence, cash is cleaner than keeping a symbolic share.
clearances.lesson_zh: 收回本金不会自动把投机仓变成核心仓。标的不在可长期跟踪的能力圈内时，现金比象征性留一股更干净。

clearances.reason_en: The tactical XLE position was closed and the energy allocation will be rebuilt through a fund DCA plan after a fresh product review. This is a vehicle and implementation change, not a rejection of energy exposure.
clearances.reason_zh: XLE 战术仓已清仓；能源敞口将在重新筛选产品后，通过基金定投重建。这是交易载体与执行方式切换，不是放弃石油能源配置。
clearances.lesson_en: When an allocation is meant to persist but does not deserve active trading attention, the vehicle should match the behavior. A low-maintenance fund DCA plan is cleaner than managing a tactical ETF position ad hoc.
clearances.lesson_zh: 当一类资产需要长期保留、却不值得持续盯盘时，交易载体必须匹配行为。低维护的基金定投，比临时管理战术 ETF 仓位更干净。

roundtables.topic_en: AI era — will electricity become the new tax base?
roundtables.topic_zh: AI 时代，电力是否会成为新税基？
roundtables.title_zh: AI 电力 · 六人圆桌

guests.name: 查理·芒格
guests.position_en: Physical facts ≠ good investments — price is the only variable that determines return
guests.position_zh: 物理事实 ≠ 好投资——价格才是决定回报的唯一变量

guests.name: 黄仁勋
guests.position_en: Electricity is the physical entry ticket for AI. 1000W per GB200, $400B data-center capex in 2026
guests.position_zh: 电力是 AI 算力的物理准入门票。单颗 GB200 1000W，2026 Capex $4000 亿

guests.name: 丹尼尔·耶金
guests.position_en: Energy-history pattern: every bottleneck eventually gets routed around. Electricity tax-base is a 5-8 year transitional window
guests.position_zh: 能源史规律：卡脖子的逻辑越成立，被绕过的速度就越快。电力税基是 5-8 年过渡性的

guests.name: 瑞·达利欧
guests.position_en: Logic-right ≠ timing-right. NAAIM 80+, Fed still QT — 58% cash suddenly going all-in on electricity is the danger signal
guests.position_zh: 逻辑对 ≠ 时机对。NAAIM 80+、美联储缩表——58% 现金突然 all in 电力本身就是危险信号

guests.name: 张五常
guests.position_en: Governments tax what's easiest to see. Tokens are easier to measure than electricity — AI tax-base is a bottleneck premium, not a tax
guests.position_zh: 政府收税看"什么最容易被看见"——token 比电表更容易计量。电力是瓶颈溢价，不是税基

guests.name: 段永平
guests.position_en: Three questions only — good business, good management, fair price. LNG / 003816 / MOD all say yes
guests.position_zh: 只问三件事——生意好、管理行、价格便宜。LNG / 003816 / MOD 三个都答"是"

rounds.core_tension_en: Is electricity an 'institutional tax-base' (permanent power node) or a 'cyclical bottleneck premium' (temporary supply-demand gap)?
rounds.core_tension_zh: 电力是"制度性税基"（永久性权力节点）还是"周期性瓶颈溢价"（过渡性供需失衡）？
rounds.fork_en: Tax-base → hold 10yr+, high PE OK, heavy nuclear (003816/CEG). Bottleneck → 5-8yr window, low PE only, cash-flow names (LNG/TLN/MOD)
rounds.fork_zh: 若是税基 → 长持 10 年+、接受高 PE、重仓核电（003816/CEG）；若是瓶颈 → 5-8 年窗口、只买低 PE、重仓现金流（LNG/TLN/MOD）

rounds.core_tension_en: Of 24 candidates, which survive the 'if AI thesis fails' stress test? All-weather: LNG / 003816 / 600900 / WMB / 600089. PE-stretched: PWR / ETN / CCJ
rounds.core_tension_zh: 24 个标的中，哪些能扛过"AI 叙事不成立也值这个价"压力测试？全天候：LNG / 003816 / 600900 / WMB / 600089。PE 偏高：PWR / ETN / CCJ
rounds.fork_en: Zhang: CN regulated electricity is a bond, US non-regulated (TLN/CEG) is the real 'AI tax-right' — can't mix
rounds.fork_zh: 张五常：中国管制电力是债券，美国非监管（TLN/CEG）才是真正"AI 收税权"——不能混配

rounds.core_tension_en: Three-bucket method: defensive base (长电/WMB, bond-like) + core offense (003816/600089, dollar-cost) + opportunistic (LNG/MOD/TLN, wait for signal)
rounds.core_tension_zh: 三桶法：防御底座（长电+WMB 类债券）+ 核心进攻（003816+600089 分月）+ 机会主义（LNG/MOD/TLN 等信号）
rounds.fork_en: Dalio: pace matters more than size. Don't all-in, don't stay all-cash — hedged, staged, event-driven
rounds.fork_zh: 达利欧：节奏比仓位更重要。不要 all-in，也不要 all-cash——对冲、分批、事件驱动

roundtables.final_verdict_en: Full conviction on the AI-electricity basket, but structural: CN hydro/nuclear as bond-like base, US non-regulated nuclear (CEG) as pure-play AI-rev. Don't pay 80x PE for cyclical names. Three-bucket execution.
roundtables.final_verdict_zh: AI 电力整组信念成立，但分层：A 股水电/核电做类债券底座、美股非监管核电（CEG）做纯 AI 收入敞口。别为周期股付 80x PE。三桶法分批。
implications_en: Long 长江电力 (600900) + 中国广核 (003816): bond-like base, hold-forever
Long CEG: US AI-PPA pure-play, high conviction
Long 特变 (600089): UHV + overseas, not AI-dependent
Watch LNG: add on pullback below $230 with R:R ≥ 2
Avoid CCJ (PE 117) and SMR (unprofitable): narrative-driven overpricing
implications_zh: 长江电力 (600900) + 中国广核 (01816) 长期持有：类债券底座
CEG 长期：美式 AI-PPA 纯敞口、高信念
特变 (600089) 长期：特高压 + 海外订单，不依赖 AI
LNG 观察：$230 以下 + R:R ≥ 2 加仓
避开 CCJ（PE 117）和 SMR（亏损）：叙事驱动过度定价

_meta.description: Public-facing capital mobility risk factor for the portfolio dashboard. Scores cross-border investment access risk from 0 to 10 using policy pressure, channel friction, legal quota pressure, enforcement intensity, and reversibility risk.

capital_mobility_risk.summary_en: Cross-border investment access is tightening; treat offshore liquidity as a strategic constraint, not just a yield choice.
capital_mobility_risk.summary_zh: 跨境投资通道正在收紧；境外流动性应被视为战略约束，而不只是收益选择。

factors.monitor_en: Multi-agency rectification, CSRC/SAFE/PBOC/NFRA announcements, illegal cross-border securities keywords.
factors.monitor_zh: 八部门整治、证监会/外管局/央行/金融监管总局公告，以及非法跨境证券关键词。

factors.monitor_en: Hong Kong bank onboarding, offshore broker China service changes, remittance and funding requirements.
factors.monitor_zh: 港卡开户要求、境外券商中国区服务变化、汇款与入金材料要求。

factors.monitor_en: QDII quota changes, fund purchase limits, QDII premium/discount, Wealth Management Connect usage.
factors.monitor_zh: QDII额度变化、基金限购、QDII溢价/折价、跨境理财通额度使用率。

factors.monitor_en: Broker/platform penalties, intermediary crackdowns, account-opening tutorial or traffic acquisition enforcement.
factors.monitor_zh: 券商/平台处罚、中介整治、开户教程或引流内容执法。

factors.monitor_en: Inbound remittance review, source-of-funds documents, tax/CRS/address proof requirements.
factors.monitor_zh: 资金回流审查、资金来源证明、税务/CRS/地址证明要求。
